text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency for /v1/generate (hosted-api, us-west-2) > 1200ms for 3m — rule=p99-latency-regression — severity=P1
morgan (oncall): Acknowledged. Oncall is paged, I'm looking. Anyone see an ongoing deploy?
jamal (sre): I'm on dashboards. spike started ~2026-03-14T11:12Z. p99 jumped from ~350ms to ~1.35s. p95 from 280ms->420ms. Streaming stalls metric spike too. :eyes: 
metrics-bot: Graph link: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/p99/hosted-api-us-west-2
morgan (oncall): Quick checks: 1) recent deploys 2) autoscaler activity 3) kv-cache misses. Jamal can you run an ad-hoc query for p95/p99 and stall rate?
jamal (sre): running queries now
jamal (sre): ```
# ad-hoc
SELECT percentile(lat_ms,95) as p95, percentile(lat_ms,99) as p99, avg(streaming_stalls_pct) as stalls
FROM requests
WHERE route = '/v1/generate' AND region='us-west-2' AND timeframe='5m'
```
jamal (sre): result: p95=420ms, p99=1.35s, stalls=0.9% (baseline stalls ~0.05%)
morgan (oncall): Not seeing 5xxs, so customer errors low. But latency impact is non-trivial. Paging SREs: @anya take lead if morgan needs to rotate.
anya (sre): I'm taking it. Starting mitigations: enable fallback routing to lower-cap models and bump dedicated pool scale by +2 nodes.
anya (sre): Pushing routing flag now.
anya (sre): ```bash
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/route-fallback \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $INFRATOKEN' \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback_model":"llama-7b-q4","duration_minutes":15}'
```
anya (sre): response: 200 OK — fallback enabled :thumbsup: 
radeg (runtime): I'll provision +2 gpus in dedicated pool. ETA ~3m.
jamal (sre): checking KV cache heatmaps — see increased eviction rate starting around same time. suspect cache thrash after a burst of large prefixes.
anya (sre): Mitigation 2: temporarily disable aggressive prefetch for streaming path (flag toggle)
anya (sre): ```
# toggle streaming prefetch
POST /admin/flags
{"streaming_prefetch_enabled":false}
```
anya (sre): done. Flag updated.
morgan (oncall): Observability update: 2m after fallback+flag, p99 down to ~620ms, p95 ~310ms. stalls down to 0.2%. Nice.
metrics-bot: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/single/hosted-api-us-west-2?panel=p99 (snapshot)
sylvia (product): Notifying top customers in us-west-2 about a transient latency spike; no errors reported. CS looped.
jamal (sre): still seeing a small tail cluster at ~1.1s for long-seq requests. Investigating whether KV cache TTLs need tuned per-model.
anya (sre): For now we'll keep fallback and scaled pools for 15m, monitor. If stable, we'll roll back flags and autoscale back down.
morgan (oncall): I need to hop into a 1pm meeting. Anya you're primary. Jamal, Radeg — take post-incident actions: open incident ticket, collect dashboard snapshots, collect sample slow traces (trace IDs), and assign action items.
anya (sre): Acknowledged. Opening incident page and assigning.
anya (sre): Incident note: p99 regression in hosted-api us-west-2, 11:12Z — 11:32Z observed. Mitigations: fallback routing, disabled streaming prefetch, scaled dedicated pool. Customer impact: increased latency for ~3% of requests; no customer-visible errors; CS notified.
morgan (oncall): Thanks team. We'll do a proper RCA tomorrow. If anything flares, @oncall escalate.
incident-bot: Incident created: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-0314-042 (assigned to anya)
anya (sre): closing this thread for live mitigation. Will file postmortem and link to this thread. :white_check_mark:
